tips.text: Start the Chem Lab research first, or confirm your clan has it; the timers run while you farm.
In a solo clan you pay every research cost yourself, including 200 Detonite Ampules and 5 Nitain Extract.
Take Invasions that reward Detonite Injectors; each pays 3 and replaces most of the crafting.
Budget for two Krohkurs, so 10 Tellurium, not 5.
Nobody complains about the craft itself; Tellurium RNG is the only recurring complaint.
